master.definition_en: A malignant, invasive embryonal neoplasm arising from the cerebellum. It occurs predominantly in children and has the tendency to metastasize via the cerebrospinal fluid pathways. Signs and symptoms include truncal ataxia, disturbed gait, lethargy, headache, and vomiting. There are four histologic variants: classic medulloblastoma, large cell/anaplastic medulloblastoma, desmoplastic/nodular medulloblastoma, and medulloblastoma with extensive nodularity.

aliases_zh: 儿童后颅窝胚胎性脑肿瘤
curated.category: 恶性肿瘤 / 儿童中枢神经系统恶性肿瘤
curated.lethality_detail_zh: 儿童最常见的恶性脑肿瘤（好发于小脑蚓部），因紧邻第四脑室，极易阻塞脑脊液循环引发急性梗阻性脑积水与枕骨大孔疝，表现为晨起喷射性呕吐、剧烈头痛及步态共济失调，脑疝发作时可在数小时内致呼吸心跳骤停；且极易沿脑脊液发生脊髓椎管播散转移。
curated.treatability_summary_zh: 总体5年生存率已达70%–80%，且高度依赖四大分子分型：WNT型预后极佳（5年生存率>95%），SHH型与Group 4型居中（约75%–85%），而伴MYC扩增或TP53突变的Group 3/SHH-TP53型预后较差（5年生存率约40%–55%）。手术全切+全脑全脊髓放疗(CSI)+联合化疗是核心治愈路径。

annual_deaths_global.range_or_note: GLOBOCAN将中枢神经系统肿瘤合并统计未单列髓母细胞瘤；儿童年发病率约5–6/百万，占儿童恶性脑肿瘤约20%，高收入国家总体5年生存率约70%–80%

annual_deaths_china.range_or_note: 中国无单列全国死亡统计；推算中国每年新发儿童及成人髓母细胞瘤约1,500–2,500例
annual_deaths_china.source: 中国儿童脑肿瘤协作组(CNOG)及神经外科临床报告

epidemiology.prevalence_global: 约70%发生在10岁以下儿童，成人仅占约15%–20%（以SHH型为主，Orphanet ORPHA:616）
epidemiology.prevalence_china: 儿童后颅窝最常见恶性肿瘤，四大分子分型占比：WNT(~10%)、SHH(~30%)、Group 3(~25%)、Group 4(~35%)

clinical_management.acute_emergency_protocol_zh: 1) 肿瘤阻塞第四脑室致急性梗阻性脑积水、意识障碍及枕骨大孔疝先兆（剧烈头痛、喷射呕吐、颈强直、呼吸节律不整）：立即抬高床头、静脉甘露醇+地塞米松脱水降颅压，急诊行脑室外引流(EVD)或内镜下第三脑室底造瘘术(ETV)挽救生命，严禁行腰椎穿刺（防诱发致命性脑疝）; 2) 术后小脑缄默综合征(CMS)：早期语言吞咽康复干预。

research_progress.breakthroughs_and_trials_zh: 1) 分子分层降阶梯与强化临床试验（SJMB12、PNET5）正尝试对预后极佳的WNT型安全降低全脑全脊髓放疗剂量(从23.4Gy降至15–18Gy)以显著改善儿童远期智商与生活质量; 2) 脑脊液ctDNA液体活检实现无创追踪分子亚型及比影像学更早数月发现MRD残留与复发; 3) 靶向Group 3 MYC扩增的CDK4/6抑制剂、BET抑制剂及脑室内注射B7-H3/HER2 CAR-T正在复发难治儿童脑肿瘤中开展1/2期临床。
research_progress.key_unmet_needs_zh: 1) Group 3(MYC扩增)及SHH-TP53突变型复发后几乎无药可救，5年生存率不足10%; 2) 全脑全脊髓放疗导致的不可逆神经认知下降、矮小症、不孕不育及放射性脑坏死亟待质子放疗与靶向替代; 3) <3岁婴幼儿尚缺兼具高治愈率与低神经毒性的靶向方案。

master.definition_en: Torticollis-keloids-cryptorchidism-renal dysplasia syndrome is an extremely rare developmental defect during embryogenesis malformation syndrome characterized by congenital muscular torticollis associated with skin anomalies (such as multiple keloids, pigmented nevi, epithelioma), urogenital malformations (including cryptorchidism and hypospadias) and renal dysplasia (e.g. chronic pyelonephritis, renal atrophy). Additional reported features include varicose veins, intellectual disability and musculoskeletal anomalies.
synonyms_en: torticollis, keloids, cryptorchidism, and renal dysplasia

master.definition_en: MRCS syndrome is a rare, genetic retinal dystrophy disorder characterized by bilateral microcornea, rod-cone dystrophy, cataracts and posterior staphyloma, in the absence of other systemic features. Night blindness is typically the presenting manifestation and nystagmus, strabismus, astigmatism and angle closure glaucoma may be associated findings. Progressive visual acuity deterioration, due to pulverulent-like cataracts, results in poor vision ranging from no light perception to 20/400.

master.name_en: undifferentiated carcinoma of liver and intrahepatic biliary tract
master.definition_en: Undifferentiated carcinoma of liver and intrahepatic biliary tract is an extremely rare epithelial tumor of the liver and biliary tract which presents heterogenous histological findings and not yet fully defined clinicopathological characteristics. Patients usually present with nonspecific signs and symptoms, such as abdominal pain, nausea, vomiting, anorexia, weight loss and/or jaundice. Invasive growth, high metastatic potential and a rapid clinical course are typically associated.

master.definition_en: A rare genetic primary lymphedema characterized by unilateral or bilateral lower limb lymphedema of variable severity. The condition shows almost complete penetrance with onset in childhood or adolescence in females, whereas in males it shows incomplete penetrance with later onset of disease. Lymphoscintigraphy in more severely affected individuals reveals lymphatic abnormalities consistent with lymphangiectasia, valve dysfunction, and thoracic duct reflux.

master.name_en: EPB41L3-related developmental disorder with delayed myelination and seizures
master.definition_en: A neurodevelopmental disorder caused by variation in the EPB41L3 gene. This disorder is characterised by global developmental delay, mild to moderate intellectual disability, early-onset seizures, and delayed myelination. Additional brain MRI abnormalities include thin corpus callosum, mild cerebellar atrophy, hyperintensities in the posterior limb of internal capsule and pyramidal tract. Other phenotypic features commonly reported include dystonia, strabismus, spasticity, tremors, and autistic features.

breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 突破跨血脑屏障转运体载体、GalNAc-siRNA / ASO 精密肝脏与中枢基因沉默调控、靶向蛋白降解嵌合体（PROTAC）及虚拟细胞药效预测技术。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: 可穿屏障肽/纳米载体生成式设计、RNA 序列稳定与毒性预测、多组学虚拟细胞扰动响应仿真。

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 单基因遗传缺陷与缺失蛋白的源头修复
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 从“提心吊胆终身服药/等待突发”走向“一次修复致病根源”
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 许多遗传病并非细胞坏了，只是基因编码少了关键一环（如 SERPINC1 缺少抗凝血酶“刹车蛋白”、SMN1 缺乏、凝血因子或酶缺陷），让患者自出生起就暴露在高危或渐进衰退中。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 推进高精度体内 CRISPR 碱基/先导编辑、低免疫原性肝/神经靶向病毒载体（AAV）与脂质纳米颗粒（LNP）递送，以及患者自体干细胞精准修复移植，让身体自己恢复生产正常蛋白。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: AI 指导低脱靶编辑器设计、肝脏/心肌/神经组织特异启动子预测、蛋白功能残基致病性建模。
